verdictRule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX. I found one MUST-FIX.
verdictBasis: Twenty-two of the twenty-three dispatched attacks are refuted against live bytes. The twenty-third lands exactly as dispatched: $.authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate drops thirteen frozen fixture directories that exist on disk and that the frozen, dual-ACCEPTed, recorded predecessor g21-fixture-corpus.v19 carried. The lineage list ran 16 entries at v11 (D-301), 18 at v16 (D-335), 19 at v19 (D-337); this candidate presents 7. No narrowing rule is declared anywhere in the subject, and no coherent narrowing rule fits the retained set: the candidate keeps g21.v11 and g21.v16 while dropping g21.v12, which holds the four D-302 per-D-002-platform copies the candidate names by decision number in three separate leaves. The claim is contradicted by disk, not merely terse. Everything else in the payload measures clean: the fixture bytes are a closed 4-byte big-endian unsigned 4294967295 with no body and are unique across every g21 fixture on disk; all four framing and intent quotes are byte-verbatim against control-protocol-contract.v2; all twenty recordedInputs digests equal live bytes; HEAD, COORD, file 08, required-now 28, and the DR-G21 OPEN token all agree; no frozen predecessor moved; nothing tracked is modified in the working tree.

findings.dispatchedAttack: authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate dropped frozen fixture directories that exist on disk
findings.claim: The candidate's non-mutation warranty enumerates seven directories: fixtures/g21.v1/, g21.v2/, g21.v7/, g21.v8/, g21.v11/, g21.v15/, g21.v16/. Thirteen frozen fixture directories that the frozen, dual-ACCEPTed, D-337-recorded predecessor g21-fixture-corpus.v19 carried in the same field are dropped, and every one of the thirteen exists on disk with files in it.
findings.measurement: Dropped, with live file counts measured on disk at HEAD 6eb703f: fixtures/g21.v3/ (2 files), g21.v4/ (2), g21.v5/ (2), g21.v6/ (2), g21.v9/ (2), g21.v10/ (1), g21.v12/ (4), g23.v3/ (4), g23.v4/ (16), g19.v1/ (12), g20.v1/ (10), g20.v2/ (10), anti-lockstep-goldens.v1/ (16). Lineage counts for the same field: g21-fixture-corpus.v11 (recorded D-301) 16 entries; v16 (recorded D-335) 18; v19 (recorded D-337) 19; this candidate 7. The field carried forward monotonically across all three recorded predecessors, each adding only the directory its own predecessor had authored. This candidate adds fixtures/g21.v16/ correctly (authored by v19 at D-337) and then removes thirteen.
findings.whyItIsNotMerelyTerse: No narrowing rule is declared. $.authoredCatalog.standing reads only 'AUTHORED-BYTES-EXIST. Digests recomputed from disk at dispatch. SHA-256 of file bytes, no canonicalization.' and states no scope for doesNotMutate. The narrowest rule a reader could reconstruct - 'directories whose corpora were recorded' - does not fit either: the recorded set is g21.v1 (D-241), g21.v2 (D-243), g21.v7 (D-245), g21.v8 (D-247), g21.v11 (D-301), g21.v12 (D-302), g21.v15 (D-335), g21.v16 (D-337), and the candidate keeps seven of those eight while dropping g21.v12. The retained set answers to no stated or reconstructible rule.
findings.whyItMatters: The dropped set is not incidental to this speaker's own claims. (a) fixtures/g21.v12/ holds the four D-302 per-D-002-platform copies of the 16777216 prefix; the candidate names 'the four D-302 copies' in $.registerRowNote, $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV20.role and $.basedOn.fixtureCorpusV11.role, and warrants at doesNot[35] that it does not reuse those bytes, while no longer warranting that it does not mutate the directory holding four copies of them. (b) fixtures/g21.v9/ and g21.v10/ are the directories COORD D-301 expressly freezes ('Frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v9 and g21-fixture-corpus.v10 stay frozen; do not record them as current'); g21.v9 holds the only 65536 prefix-exactly-at-prehandshake bytes on disk, which is the precise byte neighbourhood of this candidate's named open decision at $.findingDisposition.namedOpenDecision. (c) fixtures/anti-lockstep-goldens.v1/ (16 files) is the OBL-HOSTILE-GOLDENS material the candidate expressly disclaims at doesNot[24] and whatIsNotAuthored[28]; the disclaimer now stands without the matching non-mutation warranty. A later reader taking $.authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate at face value would conclude this speaker makes no non-mutation commitment over any of the thirteen.
findings.contradictedBy: Live disk at HEAD 6eb703f (all thirteen directories present and populated); docs/coop/artifacts/g21-fixture-corpus.v19.json $.authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate (19 entries, dual ACCEPT 0/0, recorded D-337); docs/coop/artifacts/g21-fixture-corpus.v16.json (18 entries, recorded D-335); docs/coop/artifacts/g21-fixture-corpus.v11.json (16 entries, recorded D-301).
findings.requiredFix: Restore $.authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate to carry the thirteen dropped directories alongside the seven retained, giving the twenty entries this lineage's convention produces at this point: fixtures/g21.v1/, g21.v2/, g21.v3/, g21.v4/, g21.v5/, g21.v6/, g21.v7/, g21.v8/, g21.v9/, g21.v10/, g21.v11/, g21.v12/, g21.v15/, g21.v16/, g23.v3/, g23.v4/, g19.v1/, g20.v1/, g20.v2/, anti-lockstep-goldens.v1/. fixtures/g21.v20/ stays out because this speaker authors it. Alternatively, if the intent is genuinely a narrower warranty, state the narrowing rule in $.authoredCatalog.standing and make the retained set answer to it - which the present set does not. No byte, digest, prefix value, platform token, count, leftoverDesign entry, or any other leaf is affected either way; the fixture bytes and every digest in the payload measure correct and must not move.
findings.notAClaimThat: This is not a claim that the candidate mutated anything. I verified the working tree has zero modifications to tracked files and that all five frozen predecessors named in the dispatch are byte-unchanged. The defect is the warranty's coverage, not an actual mutation.
